doc: docs/EVAL_PLAN.md section 14.6-14.7. Evaluated mechanically by eval/flies_score.py. 'ref' = prevalence-matched random reference of the SAME scored frames (frame F1: iid, expected F1 = pooled prevalence; bout F1: GT bouts shuffled to random positions, mean over 200 draws). point_min bar = max(times_ref * ref, ref + plus_ref). ci_lower_gt: 'ref' or a bar of the same form; the movie-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound must be strictly above it.

wing_threat.source: Aniket 2026-10-28: if wing threat isn't clearly above the random floor on the training split by end of Oct 31 ET, ship it as a qualitative demo clip with no F1 claim
wing_threat.window_rule: the window of the test configuration: mid5 @ 30 fps if lunge is GO, else mid10 @ 10 fps (decide lunge first)

lunge.source: ADR-002 (b): SAM sees 2 flies in >= 90% of samples AND rule bout-level recall >= 0.5 on train; evaluator adds the bout-F1 guard so that over-prediction cannot pass on recall alone
